title: AI IDE Repair Patch Plan Real Campaign Validation v0.1

acceptance: Use the existing near-real campaign fixture or equivalent non-private dry-run execution report.
Validate patch plan JSON/Markdown readability, selected task boundaries, patch preview inputs, verification commands, and maintainer review boundary.
